name: Fennel tea
description: Fennel seed steeped in hot water — drunk after heavy meals, and given to babies for colic.

tcm.note: Xiao hui xiang is warm and disperses cold from the lower abdomen.

ayurveda.note: Saunf is classically shita and pitta-pacifying — the reason it is chewed after a meal.

unani.note: Thanda in desi usage, taken against acidity — the opposite of the Chinese reading.

effects.note: Given after meals and to colicky babies across South Asian and Arabic households for easing gas and bloating. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
